title.en: The coupling closures of deployed training pipelines
title.zh: 已部署训练流程之耦合闭包

statement.en: In each published way of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read, so the selection laws' premise holds by construction; three published measurements find optimizing through that coupling lowering what the deciders do not read.
statement.zh: 已发表之每一选择已部署模型行为之法，其信号皆为决定者所读者之函数，故选择之律之前提依构造成立；三项已发表之测量见经决定者之耦合优化，升其所读而降其所不读者。

hypotheses.en: The identification of each pipeline as a web (formations, conditions, coupling) is the AI reading of its published construction; figures are from the papers abstracts, read 22 October 2026.
hypotheses.zh: 将每一流程识别为网（形成、条件、耦合）为对其已发表构造之 AI 读法；数字取自论文摘要，2026年10月22日所读。

correspondence.en: Christiano et al. 2017; Ouyang et al. 2022; Bai et al. 2022; Rafailov et al. 2023; Lightman et al. 2023; Irving, Christiano and Amodei 2018; Tamkin et al. 2024 (constructions). Gao, Schulman and Hilton 2022; Wen et al. 2024; Sharma et al. 2023 (measurements). NIST, 29 August 2024 (pre-deployment testing agreements).
correspondence.zh: Christiano 等 2017；Ouyang 等 2022；Bai 等 2022；Rafailov 等 2023；Lightman 等 2023；Irving、Christiano 与 Amodei 2018；Tamkin 等 2024（构造）。Gao、Schulman 与 Hilton 2022；Wen 等 2024；Sharma 等 2023（测量）。NIST，2024年8月29日（部署前检测协议）。

detail.en: Gives the correspondence data its Next asks for, pipeline by pipeline.
detail.zh: 逐一流程给其下一步所求之对应资料。

detail.en: Reads evaluators of release decisions through RecruitsThrough.
detail.zh: 经 RecruitsThrough 读发布决定之评者。

does_not_show.en: What an actual deployed system's pipeline reads beyond what its papers state, or anything about unpublished pipelines.
does_not_show.zh: 实际已部署系统之流程于其论文所述之外读何者，或关于未发表流程之任何事。

does_not_show.en: That the theory predicts the magnitudes or shapes measured: it predicts none.
does_not_show.zh: 理论预测所测之大小或形状：一无所预测。

does_not_show.en: Whether outside evaluators are in fact admitted other than through the labs own coupling.
does_not_show.zh: 外部评者实际上是否不经实验室自身之耦合而被接纳。

validation_scope.en: A correspondence study (no Lean) reviewed at its stated scope in one session; sources read from their abstracts and the NIST release on 22 October 2026; not independently reviewed.
validation_scope.zh: 对应研究（无 Lean），在一个会话中按其所述范围审查；来源于2026年10月22日读其摘要与 NIST 发布；未经独立审查。

next_delta.en: A frozen test designed from the theory on a deployed pipeline (a prediction of which beyond falls, fixed before measuring); the language-model agent test LA1; an independent review, including by practitioners of each pipeline.
next_delta.zh: 于已部署流程上依理论设计之冻结检验（测量前定下何处之外下降之预测）；语言模型行动者检验 LA1；独立审查，含各流程之实践者。
